provision.describe: TradingView primary-account cookies (SESSION / SIGNATURE / DEVICE_T / TV_USER / TV_TIER) — legacy single-account auth for tvcli + tvvisual --env
multi-account WS registry (accounts.json) powering the account pool, /hunt parallel multi-symbol analysis and round-robin failover — rides as an item attachment (Bitwarden caps notes at 10k chars)
browser-debug canonical env: TV session cookies (tv.mjs headful authenticated launch) + MISTRAL_API_KEY (vision.mjs screenshot understanding)
OpenCode LLM provider credentials (Cloudflare Workers AI: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID / CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY)

WunderTrading HMAC API key pair (WT_API_KEY / WT_API_SECRET) — powers the wt CLI + wt_* dsh tools (vault seam), the mcp-wundertrading row written by prime-stack's fleet tag, and the wundertrading workspace skill

WunderTrading web-session cookies (WT_PHPSESSID / WT_CF_CLEARANCE / WT_COOKIES_JSON) for the headful CloakBrowser wt.mjs launcher — restored via CDP Network.setCookie; refresh by re-running the login flow and exporting back to the vault (bw-provision.sh --export wundertrading-session)

Kimi.ai web session from Google OAuth (KIMI_ACCESS_TOKEN / KIMI_REFRESH_TOKEN / KIMI_USER_ID / KIMI_DEVICE_ID / KIMI_SSID) — headless Kimi Code console access + provider key refresh (loginWithThirdParty → access_token/refresh_token)

opencode.ai web session (OPENCODE_AUTH / OPENCODE_PROVIDER / OPENCODE_WORKSPACE_ID / OPENCODE_USER_EMAIL + expiry timestamps) — httpOnly cookie auth for opencode-usage.mjs subs/usage-limits API; refresh by re-exporting the auth cookie to the vault (bw-provision.sh --export opencode-session)
